newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's Cahya Mata to list unit shrs.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's Cahya Mata to list unit shrs.

text.p: Malaysian infrastructure construction firm Cahya Mata Sarawak Bhd said it is applying for regulatory approval to list the stock of a 57.3 percent-owned banking unit on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange.
In a statement released late on Friday, it said it sought to make a public offering of 77.6 million shares in Utama Banking Group Bhd at an issue price to be determined later.
The proceeds would be used for an increase in investments in the banking group's units and for working capital and future investments, Cahya Mata said.
Upon completion of the proposed listing on the main board of the exchange, Cahya Mata's shareholding in the banking unit would be 50.7 percent, it said.
The proposal requires the approval of the Securities Commission, Bank Negara Malaysia and other bodies.
Cahya Mata's stock, which had been suspended pending a news announcement, will resume trading on Monday, the stock exchange said in an attached statement.
Shares of the company closed at 20 ringgit on November 8.
